Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 34

“People will speak of your lasting disgrace, and for one who has been honoured, dishonour is worse than death.”

A hard, worldly argument aimed at Arjuna's standing rather than his soul. Krishna uses every register available — the higher teaching has not landed yet, so he tries reputation instead.
